# Agent Ray — the Tenderfy explainer film

**File:** `showcase-ray.html`, generated by `build-showcase.py`
**Local:** `~/Documents/Claude Project/tenderfy-landing/showcase-ray.html`
**Live:** https://daandydoan.github.io/tenderfy-landing/showcase-ray.html

## What it is

An autoplaying HTML/CSS explainer film walking through "The Tenderfy Method."
Every screen is a **recreated skeleton/mockup UI** — a document mockup +
Ray chat panel that overlap naturally via CSS (no real app footage, no video
clips) — surrounded by ambient decoration (drifting orbs, streaks, file/chip/
score fragments) as visual texture. This recreation is what the film's own
scenes are built from, and it's also the source the [8 WordPress Custom HTML
blocks](extracts/wp-blocks/) for `tenderfy.org/product/` were later derived
from.

## Design details

- **Hover-only player controls** — hidden by default, revealed on hover, like
  a real video player.
- **Hook screen:** the Ray icon sits to the left of "Agent Ray," not stacked
  above it.
- **Ray chat panel:** bigger, light-themed; the two redundant "Agentic Ray"
  headers were removed; the Tenderfy logo moved to top-right.
- **Doc + Ray panel overlap** is native CSS behavior — `.win.deck` computes
  `position:relative` (flows normally, sized via `.v5.with-panel .stage-app
  .win.deck{width:58%}`), `.raypanel` computes `position:absolute;
  right:-6px; bottom:0` — no manual position-forcing needed once
  `.scene{position:relative;visibility:visible}` and a concrete
  `.stage-app` height are set.

## Generator — three variants from one script

`build-showcase.py` builds all three; only V5 is actively iterated:

- `showcase-agentic.html` — **V1**, untouched.
- `showcase-ray.html` — **V5**, this film, the one under active iteration.
- `showcase-agentic-ray.html` — **V4**, protected — must stay byte-identical
  unless explicitly requested (gated in the generator via a `BARE` flag).

## The 8-step content (also reused for the live site)

Go/No-Go → Plan → Add value → Continuous improvement → Build from library →
Structured responses → Collaborate → Deliver — recreated as 8 standalone
Custom HTML blocks for `tenderfy.org/product/`. See
[`extracts/wp-blocks/SESSION-HANDOFF.md`](extracts/wp-blocks/SESSION-HANDOFF.md)
for that track's full handoff.
